title: Eckhard Boles
text: Eckhard Boles (born September 4, 1963, in Altena) is a German microbiologist and biotechnologist. Since 2002 he is professor of microbiology at the Goethe University Frankfurt with a focus on the physiology and genetics of lower eukaryotes. He retired in September 2024. He works mainly on the optimization of yeasts for industrial biotechnology.
